title: The nimshal in G-d: Yachid, Echad, Kadmon, and the fourth level after the tzimtzum
overview: Chapter 11 is the *nimshal* of chapter 10: the three levels of the soul's powers, applied to G-d. In *Yachid*, the *Atzmus Or Ein Sof* before the *tzimtzum*, the ten *sefiros* are "hidden in the very essence". G-d's *chafetz chesed*, His power to create, includes every *sefira* the way a kind person's kindness includes the intellect, emotions and deeds of every kindness he will do, with none of them there as a separate thing; you cannot teach a computer to be kind. Even *Malchus*, His pleasure from others listening to Him, is there, and it is infinite, which is why the smallest detail of a *mitzva* matters. *Echad* is the light that shines and spreads: *sefiros* without end, united and still "without a what", like the man who wants to do a nice thing and does not know what. *Kadmon* is the whole estimation in letters, down to the hairs on your head, like the basketball player who has not yet thrown. A fourth level, the *reshimu* and the *Kav* after the *tzimtzum*, is brought here to show that everything after it was first in the Essence. The chapter ends by reading the levels into *Baruch She'amar*.

terms.gloss: the desire for kindness; above, G-d's power to create, the reason for the simple will to make the whole chain
the concealed essential state: a simple essence that includes every detail with none of them there as a separate thing
the upper purity: only G-d, revealed to Himself, where nothing is seen even as separate from Him
the kingship of the Infinite: the ability to take pleasure from others listening to Him, infinite in the Essence
a commandment done just because G-d said so; in their essence all the mitzvos are a chok
sefiros without a what: separate things that have no distinct nature yet
preceding: He already preceded within Himself exactly how He will give, every detail pre-planned
the impression of the original light left after the first tzimtzum: the letters of Kadmon without the light in them
the lower purity: the reshimu and the start of the Kav, G-d's revelation relating to something separate, the general makif of the chain
hidden: "Blessed is He" in the third person, the source of the world whose identity is hidden
the measuring line before Adam Kadmon, which divides the light into ten circles as estimated in the reshimu

sections.title: Yachid: every attribute is in the Essence the way kindness is in a kind person
sections.summary: The *nimshal* of the soul's three levels begins with the *Atzmus Or Ein Sof* before the *tzimtzum*, called *Yachid*. There the ten *sefiros* are "hidden in the very essence": G-d's *chafetz chesed*, His power to create, includes every *sefira*, and so does His *Malchus*, the way a kind person's kindness includes every detail of every kindness he will do, with none of them there as a separate thing.

phrases.he: (יא) והנמשל מכל הנזכר לעיל בנפש
phrases.en: the *nimshal* for everything that we spoke about in the previous chapter regarding the soul,

phrases.he: יובן למשכיל
phrases.en: the correspondence to these three levels is understood to a *maskil*, to somebody that knows how to find the abstract point, the *chachma*,

phrases.he: למעלה בעצמות אור אין סוף שלפני הצמצום
phrases.en: it's understood above in G-dliness, in the essence of the infinite light that precedes the *tzimtzum*,

phrases.he: שנקרא יחיד
phrases.en: which this light is called *Yachid*, alone, single,

phrases.he: וכלול גם שם מעשר ספירות,
phrases.en: and even there are included ten *sefiros*,

phrases.he: ונקרא עשר ספירות הגנוזות בהעלם העצמות ממש
phrases.en: And these are called the ten hidden away *sefiros* in the concealment of the very essence, the very self.

blocks.text: **The nimshal for everything that we spoke about in the previous chapter regarding the soul**, the three levels in which the powers come from the *yechida* (the essence of the soul), **is understood to a maskil** (a person of intellect): above, **in the essence of the infinite light that precedes the tzimtzum** (contraction), called *Yachid*, **alone, single**.

**And even there are included ten sefiros**, **the ten hidden away sefiros**: not, as usual, the *sefiros* in *Adam Kadmon*, but as hidden in the *Atzmus Ein Sof* (the essence of the Infinite) before the *tzimtzum*.

phrases.he: כמו בחינת חפץ חסד שכלול בבחינת עצמיות דאור אין סוף,
phrases.en: like the desire for kindness, which was included in the essence of the infinite light,

phrases.he: שמחמתו וסיבתו היה הרצון הפשוט לכל ההשתלשלות,
phrases.en: that because of it and as a result of it came the simple desire for the entire *hishtalshelus*.

phrases.he: שזהו בדבר פרט
phrases.en: which this is a detail.

phrases.he: כמו שכתוב בעץ חיים בהקדמה,
phrases.en: like it says in *Etz Chaim* in the introduction,

phrases.he: כשעלה ברצונו הפשוט כו'
phrases.en: when it came up in G-d's simple desire to create the world,

phrases.he: ובודאי סיבת עליית הרצון הפשוט בעצמותו היינו רק כי חפץ חסד הוא בעצמו
phrases.en: and the reason for this simple desire in Himself to create the world is because He desires kindness within Himself.

phrases.he: על כן
phrases.en: therefore,

phrases.he: עלה ברצונו להטיב חסדו
phrases.en: therefore it arose in desire to make good, in other words, to express His kindness,

phrases.he: להיות מקור למקור להשתלשלות דקו וחוט כו'
phrases.en: to make a source for a source for the *hishtalshelus* of the *kavim*, etc.

blocks.text: **Like the desire for kindness, which was included in the essence of the infinite light**, from which came **the simple desire for the entire hishtalshelus** (the chain of descent), **a detail**: as a *chafetz chesed* (one who desires kindness) wants to help the poor man he sees, or to buy a friend a birthday present. So the desire for this *hishtalshelus*, with its ten *sefiros*, is the particular thing.

**In Etz Chaim in the introduction**: **when it came up in G-d's simple desire to create the world**, the reason was **because He desires kindness within Himself**. **Therefore it arose in desire to make good**: **to make a source for a source for the hishtalshelus**.

*Tanya* explains *chesed* above as G-d's *koach* (power) to create and give life without end. The *chafetz chesed* is there because He is a Creator, and the *hishtalshelus* reveals that ability, as a kind person expresses his kindness in a particular desire.

Creation is separate and limited, yet its source must be G-d: only a Creator makes a creation, and only G-d can be one. So the *sefiros* are in *Yachid* not *mamash* (actually) as *sefiros*; their *yecholes* (ability) comes from the *etzem* (essence).

phrases.he: והרי זה על דרך דוגמא
phrases.en: this is similar,

phrases.he: כשמחמת עצמיות המדה דחפץ חסד הכלולה בבחינת יחידה כנזכר לעיל,
phrases.en: like when, as a result of a person's essential desire for kindness, which is included in his *yechida*,

phrases.he: עולה ברצונו לעשות טוב וחסד בדבר פרט כנזכר לעיל
phrases.en: It then comes up in his desire to do a particular *chesed* and *tov* in a particular way,

phrases.he: שבא בגלוי מן העלמו ההיולי דחפץ חסד,
phrases.en: and then it becomes revealed from its concealed *hiyuli*, its concealed essential state in his essential desire for *chesed*,

phrases.he: לכלול כל מה שיעלה בפרט ברצונו להטיב
phrases.en: and now it becomes a desire that includes everything that will come up in detail, every detail that he'll ever want to do, every kindness he'll ever want to do.

phrases.he: הכל בא מחמתו וכחו כו'
phrases.en: Everything comes as a result of and through the power of this *chafetz chesed*.

blocks.text: **As a result of a person's essential desire for kindness, which is included in his yechida, it then comes up in his desire to do a particular chesed**, **revealed from its concealed hiyuli** (raw potential) as a desire **that includes everything that will come up in detail**: **everything comes as a result of and through the power of this chafetz chesed.**
It is all an expression of the *chafetz chesed*. So too the whole *hishtalshelus* is a *gilui* (revelation) of G-d's essential *yecholes* to create.

blocks.question: How can the hishtalshelus, a creation of something separate from G-d, have its source in the Atzmus Ein Sof?
blocks.text: This is what chapters 10 and 11 come to explain. G-d cannot be defined as only this, but among other things He surely is a Creator. So knowing Him includes the creations, since His ability to create is known through them, and G-d, knowing what He is, knows all He can make.

phrases.he: וכמו שבגלוי רצון שבא מחמת חפץ חסד זה,
phrases.en: and just like the revealed desire of kindness that comes as a result of this essential desire for kindness,

phrases.he: כלול מי', חב''ד ומדות כו'
phrases.en: just like when it's revealed it includes ten *sefiros*, that there's the *Chabad* and the *middos* and the *machshava*, *dibur* and *maaseh*.

phrases.he: מזה מוכרח שגם בבחינת חפץ חסד ההיולי שכלול בעצמות ממש, כלול מי', חכמה ומדות כו'
רק שלא יתכן בהם לומר גם ענין ההתכללות והאחדות,
phrases.en: Only that even though we're saying that all these ten powers must be there in the kindness, you can't say that they are separate things that unite and are included in one there,

phrases.he: אחר שכלול בעצמות בבחינת היולי עדיין כו'
phrases.en: because they're completely one with the self, and they're still like a simple essence. They're still what's called a *hiyuli*, a simple essence.

blocks.text: Back to the person: **just like the revealed desire of kindness** **includes ten sefiros**, *Chabad* (*chachma*, *bina* and *daas*), the *middos* (emotional attributes), and *machshava*, *dibur* and *maaseh* (thought, speech and action), he has a whole *sechel* (intellect) and *middos* for how to do the *chesed*.

When he actually does a kindness, it comes out with intellect, emotions and the rest, so they are inherent in it. Kindness is one way the soul expresses itself, done with *sechel*, *middos*, thought, speech and action, and he knows how to make each come out as *chesed*. So all these details were included in the essence of kindness in his soul.

**Only that even though** all ten must be there, **you can't say that they are separate things that unite and are included in one there**, **because they're completely one with the self**: still a *hiyuli*, **a simple essence**.

As explained in *Kuntres Inyana shel Toras HaChassidus* and elsewhere, an essence is higher than everything and goes into everything, like oil, which mixes with nothing and permeates everything. So the real essence of kindness is higher than any detail or explanation.

So only a person can really be kind. No checklist (do this and that, and smile) could teach a computer kindness, because real kindness is essentially beyond explanation: "It's a higher thing. It's an essence."

Once you have that point, it comes out by itself in everything, each in its own way. One who appreciates the *chesed* will know how to bring it out in *sechel*, *middos*, thought, speech and action; one who does not can make them look like it, and it still will not really be *chesed*.

This is the *etzem*. The *hiyuli* of the *chesed* includes all ten, yet there is only the *chesed*; you see no *sechel* or *middos* there. So above: the *hishtalshelus* comes out in ten *sefiros*, but all included in one thing, the *chesed*, His power of being a Creator.

phrases.he: וכמו כן במדה זולתה,
phrases.en: in the same way with another *midda*,

phrases.he: כמו מדת הגבורה
phrases.en: like the *midda* of *gevura*, of severity, of judgment, of limitation,

phrases.he: או הנצח
phrases.en: or the *midda* of victory, of conquering, of enduring, overcoming obstacles,

phrases.he: והתפארת
phrases.en: and of beauty,

phrases.he: וכהאי גוונא
phrases.en: and the like,

phrases.he: הכל הוא כלול בעצמיות דאור אין סוף
phrases.en: All of these are included in the self, the essence of the *Ein Sof*,

phrases.he: שנקרא טהירו עילאה
phrases.en: which is called the upper purity.

phrases.he: והוא הנקרא יחיד
phrases.en: and this is what is called *Yachid*, alone, single,

phrases.he: שלמעלה מאחד פשוט כו'
phrases.en: which is higher than a simple *Echad*, a simple unity, simple one, which already recognizes parts.

blocks.text:
**In the same way with another midda** (attribute): **the midda of gevura, of severity, of judgment, of limitation**; *netzach*, **victory**; and *tiferes*, **beauty**.

*Gevura*: G-d can limit and hide His light, make a *tzimtzum*. *Netzach*: through any *tzimtzum* or *hishtalshelus* He endures, and even in the lowest place His *gilui* (revelation) is there.

*Tiferes*: beauty is not one color but many, even opposites, put together. So *tiferes* is G-d's ability to join opposites, like the soul, eternal and spiritual, and the body, limited and physical, until they are like one thing.

blocks.title: The Ark that took up no space
blocks.text: So G-d joins being *l'maala min hateva* (higher than nature) with time and space, above all in the Ark in the Holy Temple. The Ark measured two and a half cubits and the Holy of Holies ten, yet from each side of the Ark to the wall was five cubits: "It did not take up two and a half."

**And the like**: all ten are included **in the self, the essence of the Ein Sof, which is called the upper purity**, *tehiru ila'a*. Pure, like pure oil, is one thing only: only G-d. The lower purity shows something separate that reveals Him; here it is not even seen as separate.

**And this is what is called Yachid, alone, single**: only G-d. By what He is, He is the essence of all possible existence and includes the ten *sefiros*, but you see them as no existence at all. Knowing what it is to be the *Aibershter* (the One Above), you know He can do anything, *chesed*, *chachma*, *gevura*, *netzach*, *hod*, without thinking of them. This is **higher than a simple Echad, a simple unity, simple one, which already recognizes parts**.

phrases.he: עד בחינת מדת המלוכה בעצמות אור אין סוף
phrases.en: until there's even the *midda* of *melucha*, the attribute of kingship, in the *Atzmus* of the infinite light,

phrases.he: שנקרא מלכות דאין סוף
phrases.en: which is called *Malchus* of *Ein Sof*.

phrases.he: גם הוא כלול בבחינת היולי העצמי דעצמות אור אין סוף
phrases.en: that even this, even the attribute of *Malchus*, is included in the self-*hiyuli*, the essential power of the *Atzmus Or Ein Sof*, of the essence of the infinite light.

phrases.he: שהוא בבחינת אין סוף ממש
phrases.en: and it is completely infinite,

blocks.text: **Until there's even the midda of melucha, the attribute of kingship**, **which is called Malchus of Ein Sof** (the kingship of the Infinite): **even this…is included** in the essential *hiyuli* of the *Atzmus Or Ein Sof*.

blocks.question: Why is it stressed that even Malchus is there?
blocks.text: *Malchus*, explained later, is pleasure from others praising you and being *mevatel* themselves (setting themselves aside) under you. Relating to something separate, it might seem missing from the *Atzmus Or Ein Sof*. No: G-d can do anything, and can have pleasure from something separate, being a king.

His pleasure is that others listen: that you actually went and put on *tefillin* this morning, not only that He told you to. That ability too is in the *Atzmus Or Ein Sof*, **and it is completely infinite**, like all the other powers.

phrases.he: וכמו שחפץ חסד בבחינת אין סוף ממש בעצמות,
phrases.en: just like G-d's desire for kindness is infinite in His essence,

phrases.he: או לחכמתו אין סוף,
phrases.en: or that we say that to His wisdom there's no end, that His wisdom is *Ein Sof*,

phrases.he: כך מדת ההתנשאות
phrases.en: so too the attribute of leadership, of being above, raised above others,

phrases.he: שכלול בעצמות אור אין סוף
phrases.en: which is included in the essence of the infinite light,

phrases.he: הוא בבחינת אין סוף
phrases.en: it is also infinite.

phrases.he: וכלול מי' בהעלם העצמות,
phrases.en: it also includes ten *sefiros*, the way that it's in the concealment of G-d's essence,

phrases.he: שהוא בחינת הרצון והתענוג וחכמה ומדות שבמדות המלוכה
phrases.en: which this is the desire, and the pleasure, and the wisdom, and the emotions of the attribute of kingship.

blocks.text: **Just like G-d's desire for kindness is infinite**, and **to His wisdom there's no end**, **so too the attribute of leadership**, *hisnasus*, **is also infinite**.

blocks.question: What does it mean that His hisnasus is infinite?
blocks.text: G-d can not only decide to care about what we do but care infinitely, giving infinite importance to the smallest *diyuk* (detail): this way the *mitzva* (commandment) is kosher, that way not. What does G-d care? He decided to be a king, and His *Malchus* is infinite: "if He decides to care, nobody can care like He can."

So the *mitzvos*, and their *diyukim*, must follow *halacha* (Jewish law). The *tefillin* are perfect, but one letter is missing a little drop, and they are nothing; or he puts them a little off on his arm, and it is as if he did not put them on. It is all *Ein Sof*.

*Chesed* and *Malchus* are stressed as the main *middos* relating to the whole world. Creation was pure *chesed*, since nobody was there. But the *pnimiyus* (inner part) of the *ratzon* (will) was *Malchus*: to be King over the Jews, and the gentiles keeping the seven commandments, that we do the *mitzvos* and make a *dira b'tachtonim* (a dwelling below), an extra *taanug* (delight). The world of itself is from *chesed*; its *pnimiyus*, Torah and *mitzvos*, from *Malchus*.

This *Malchus* also **includes ten sefiros**: **the desire, and the pleasure, and the wisdom, and the emotions of the attribute of kingship**, the source of all the *mitzvos* and the Torah's wisdom. Included in His being King is over whom (*b'mi nimlach*, over whom shall I rule? *b'nishmasan shel tzaddikim*, with the souls of the righteous) and which *mitzvos* He will give.

A kind person knows the essence of kindness, so he knows how his *chachma*, *bina* and *middos* should be kind; the details are not separate things. So G-d's wanting to be King includes the *ratzon*, *taanug*, *sechel* and *middos* of a king. He could do it differently, but kingship always comes out in certain ways.

One is the *chok* (a commandment without a reason): though the *mitzvos* come onto a *sechel*, in essence each is a *chok*, done because G-d said so, not because it makes sense. Other such things define *melucha*; *Malchus* comes up much more at the end of the book.
blocks.outOfPlace: Class 20 opens by finishing class 19's point on line 21, before it reads line 22.

phrases.he: אך ענין אנא אמלוך
phrases.en: But the idea of *Ana Emloch*, that it says that Hashem said to Himself, "I want to be king,"

phrases.he: שעלה ברצונו ומחשבתו הפשוט,
phrases.en: That's when it came up in His simple *ratzon* and *machshava*,

phrases.he: היינו כשבא בדבר פרט,
phrases.en: which is a particular thing,

phrases.he: לבחינת ההשתלשלות בגלוי מהעלמו ההיולי
phrases.en: for the *hishtalshelus*, when it's revealed from its concealed state,

phrases.he: כנזכר לעיל במדה דחפץ חסד באדם למטה,
phrases.en: like we've said before about the *midda* of the *chafetz chesed* in a person below.

phrases.he: וכנזכר לעיל במשל י' כחות הכלולים שבבחינת יחידה,
phrases.en: like we explained in last chapter about the ten *kochos*, the way they're included in the *yechida*,

phrases.he: בבחינת היולי ועצמיות כו'
phrases.en: they're in the way of an essence and one with the self,

phrases.he: שאינן נבדלים מן העצם כלל
phrases.en: that they're not separate from the essence, the self, at all,

phrases.he: וכמו כח התנועה שכלול בעצם החי,
phrases.en: like the power of movement that's included in the essence of a living thing,

phrases.he: וכהתפשטות החיות ההיולי הכלול בעצם הנפש ממש כנזכר לעיל
phrases.en: And like the power of consciousness the way it's included in the essence of the soul *mamash*, like we explained in last chapter.

blocks.text: **But the idea of Ana Emloch** (I shall rule), **that it says that Hashem said to Himself, "I want to be king,"** is lower than kingship in His essence, *Yachid*, where simply being G-d He can be king. It is an actual *aliyas haratzon* (rising of the will), **when it came up in His simple ratzon and machshava**, **a particular thing**, as with the *chafetz chesed* of a person below.

There, *Yachid* was the essential kindness, before any particular desire to give a coat, shoes, a present. **Like we explained in last chapter about the ten kochos** (powers) in the *yechida*, **they're in the way of an essence and one with the self**: really just you.

**Like the power of movement that's included in the essence of a living thing**, and consciousness in the soul, chapter 10's first level is wholly one with the self. So *Yachid* is a *gilui* of G-d as He is: an essence beyond all limits and divisions, which can therefore come into anything. Next: *Echad*.

sections.title: Echad: the light that shines and spreads, ten sefiros without a what
sections.summary: Below *Yachid* is the infinite light that shines and spreads, still in G-d's essence before the *tzimtzum*: the *sefiros* "without end", which can be known without being G-d. There the *sefiros* are separate things united, a simple unity, yet *b'li ma*, without a what, like the man who wants to do a nice thing and cannot yet say what.

phrases.he: ולמטה מזה
phrases.en: and lower than this, lower than *Yachid*,

phrases.he: הוא בחינת אור אין סוף המאיר ומתפשט
phrases.en: is the infinite light that shines and spreads.

phrases.he: והכל עדיין בבחינת עצמותו לפני הצמצום
phrases.en: but this is still in Himself, in the essence, in G-d's essence before the *tzimtzum*.

blocks.text: **And lower than this, lower than Yachid, is the infinite light that shines and spreads.** *Basi L'Gani* (25 and 46) makes *l'maala maala ad ein ketz* (higher and higher without end) and *l'mata mata ad ein tachlis* (lower and lower without limit) two levels in the *Or Ein Sof*: the first is *Yachid*; *Echad* and *Kadmon* are the light that relates to coming down, *meir u'mispashet* (shines and spreads).

**But this is still in Himself**, before the *tzimtzum*. *Echad* is *sefiros ad ein ketz* (*sefiros* without end): G-d can make infinite *sefiros*, and infinite other ways to reveal Himself. But a *sefira* is already a revelation going out in a limited way, which can be revealed as separate from Him: *chesed* is already not G-d, only *chesed*. So it can be *meir u'mispashet*.

The essence is G-d Himself: *yedaativ hayisiv* (if I knew Him, I would be Him), so it cannot be revealed outside Him. Once it is *meir u'mispashet*, you can know what kindness or *chachma* is without being G-d.

All this is still in His essence before the *tzimtzum*. That means: before G-d makes the *tzimtzum*, part of knowing Himself is knowing all the *sefiros* He could reveal and make, if He were to make a *tzimtzum* and a *hishtalshelus*.

blocks.title: Sitting G-d down to ask, and the teacher
blocks.text: Sit G-d down and ask how He would make a world, and He could tell you exactly, and every other way He could make one. It is the usual *mashal* of a teacher, who knows the subject above explaining it and also as he could explain it: this level is being able to explain it.

phrases.he: וזהו הנקרא אחדות הפשוטה
phrases.en: this is what's called a simple unity,

phrases.he: שיתכן שם בחינת התכללות ואחדות בעשר ספירות
phrases.en: There you can speak of the ten *sefiros* as being separate things that are included and united.

phrases.he: וגם הם נקרא עשר ספירות בלי מה,
phrases.en: but they're also called the ten *sefiros b'li ma*, without a what, meaning without a *mahus*.

phrases.he: כי הוא למעלה גם מבחינת הכנה להשפעה למטה בגלוי עדיין
phrases.en: because it's still before the preparation to give something, to reveal something below.

phrases.he: רק שמוכן לצאת מההיולי בדבר פרט
phrases.en: just that it is ready to come out from the essence to a particular thing.

blocks.text: **This is what's called a simple unity**: **there you can speak of the ten sefiros as being separate things that are included and united.** *Chachma* and *chesed* are seen as separate, and G-d as the being who has them all, every ability. Really He is higher still, which is *Yachid*.

That does not define G-d. A being with infinite *sefiros*, every power, is like a magic wand with every magic power: the best a philosopher could come up with, and it "totally doesn't reach G-d." Outside the *etzem* you never reach it, but this is the best kind of *gilui*.

**The ten sefiros b'li ma, without a what, meaning without a mahus** (what a thing is in itself): you cannot say what they are, **because it's still before the preparation to give something, to reveal something below.**

blocks.title: "I want to do a nice thing." "What?" "I don't know."
blocks.text: A person wants to give his friend a present but does not yet know what. Ask what he will do: something nice. What? He does not know. A present: what, and how will he get it? He does not know. He has no *ma*: he cannot tell you what.

So here, at the highest level of the *sefiros* before they have vessels, you cannot really say what is *chesed* and what is *gevura*; the distinction is lost. **It is ready to come out from the essence to a particular thing**, but has not yet, so it can still come out in any way.

phrases.he: כמו חפץ חסד ההיולי הנזכר לעיל,
phrases.en: like the *chafetz chesed hiyuli* that we explained before,

phrases.he: כשבא לענין הרצון וחפץ חסד בהשתלשלות דקו כו'

blocks.text: **Like the chafetz chesed hiyuli that we explained before**, the second stage is when G-d's desire to reveal Himself as Creator comes to actually making a *hishtalshelus*. Here there is already recognition of *pratim* (particulars), separate things: creation is something separate from Him.

In *Yachid*, knowing what G-d is, we know He can also create, though we do not define Him as a Creator. Here we appreciate the Creator through the power of creation: G-d showing you all He could create reveals Him, but already recognizes something separate.

So *Echad*, before any particular *hishtalshelus*, already recognizes parts, yet is still in the *Atzmus Ein Sof*: revealing that He is a Creator, not the creations He could make.

phrases.he: גם שלא יצא עדיין בגלוי גמור,
phrases.en: even though it wasn't revealed yet,

phrases.he: גם בעצמו,
phrases.en: even to Himself.

phrases.he: על כל פנים שם יתכן בחינת אחדות והתכללות
phrases.en: Nevertheless, at least, there you can already say that there are separate things that are united and included.

phrases.he: רק שנקרא אחדות הפשוטה
phrases.en: but this is called a simple unity still,

phrases.he: בהיותו עדיין באור עצמותו הפשוט בתכלית
phrases.en: because we're speaking about the way that all of these things are in the light, the revelation of G-d's essence, which is completely simple.

phrases.he: וכמו בחינת התחלקות שכל ומדות כו' שבחפץ חסד זה,
phrases.en: and this is like the divisions of intellect and emotions and everything else, *machshava*, *dibur* and *maaseh*, in the desire for kindness.

phrases.he: שמחמתו הוא שעלה ברצונו וחכמתו להטיב כו'
phrases.en: that because of this desire, it arose in His *ratzon* and in His wisdom to do good.

phrases.he: גם טרם בואו לגלוי כלל וכלל כו',
phrases.en: even before it's revealed at all, in any way of the details of it.

phrases.he: וכנזכר לעיל במדריגה הב' בנפש האדם.
phrases.en: like we discussed previously in the last chapter about the second stage in the soul of man.

blocks.text: It is not yet the creations: this is the power of creation. To appreciate being a Creator you appreciate the power of creation, and then the creations, the next level.

**Even though it wasn't revealed yet, even to Himself**: G-d had not yet made the *hashara* (estimation) and *tzimtzum* to shape it, and this is not a matter of time. It is the power of *chesed* itself, *sefiros ein ketz*: not our *sefira* of *chesed* but its *inyan* (idea) in the *etzem*, the *l'mata mata*.

**There you can already say that there are separate things that are united and included**, though not yet as a *ma*, with no defined *metzius* (existence). **But this is called a simple unity still**: these are in **the revelation of G-d's essence, which is completely simple.** A person has ten *sefiros*, G-d *sefiros ein ketz*, and you cannot define the parts: they could be divided in infinite ways, with no inherent divisions yet.

**And this is like the divisions of intellect and emotions** in **the desire for kindness**: **because of this desire, it arose in His ratzon and in His wisdom to do good**, **even before it's revealed at all**. Once there is an actual *aliyas haratzon* to do *chesed*, it is recognized that it will come out in parts, in a certain *tzura* (form); with no estimation yet, no details can be named. It is still simple, as in the soul's second stage in the last chapter. That is *Echad*.

sections.title: Kadmon: every detail already estimated, before the first tzimtzum
sections.summary: The third level is the *ratzon* already prepared with the whole estimation in letters of how the influence will come out, like the basketball player who knows exactly how to shoot and has not thrown: *glif glifu*, down to the hairs on your head. It precedes the giving, and it is still before the first *tzimtzum*, so even the apple was there in the *Or Ein Sof*.

phrases.he: והג'
phrases.en: the third level, which is what's called *Kadmon*,

phrases.he: כאשר מבחינת חפץ חסד זה
phrases.en: when from this desire for kindness,

phrases.he: הוא שעלה כבר ברצון ושכל כו'
phrases.en: it already arose in His *ratzon* and *sechel*, it already came up as an actual desire to do the *chesed*,

phrases.he: והוכן בכל השיעור באותיות ששיער בעצמו
phrases.en: it was prepared with the entire estimation in letters that He estimates to Himself,

phrases.he: איך יהיה איכות אופן ההשפעה ממש לחוץ מעצמותו
phrases.en: exactly how the *hashpaa* is going to come out from Him, in which way it will come out,

blocks.text: **The third level, which is what's called Kadmon** (preceding): once the desire to do the *chesed* has arisen, **it was prepared with the entire estimation in letters that He estimates to Himself**, letters meaning anything expressed in a limited way (more on them later): **exactly how the hashpaa** (the influence) **is going to come out from Him**.

phrases.he: על דרך דוגמא מכח התנועה המוכן איך להניע
phrases.en: like this is like the power of movement, when he's prepared, he knows exactly how he's going to move.

phrases.he: וכח החיות המוכן איך להחיות
phrases.en: or like the power of consciousness which is ready now to enliven the body,

phrases.he: כשמוכנים כבר בשיעור ואופן מוגבל,
phrases.en: and they're prepared already with an estimation and in a limited way.

phrases.he: כנזכר לעיל בענין מדריגה הג' בנפש
phrases.en: like we explained before about the third level in the soul of man,

blocks.title: The basketball player who never shoots
blocks.text: **Like the power of movement, when he's prepared, he knows exactly how he's going to move**: a really good basketball player about to shoot, sure to score, but somebody grabs the ball before he throws.

blocks.title: The eye ready to see
blocks.text: **Or like the power of consciousness which is ready now to enliven the body**: it is *mamash* ready, already in the physical eye, ready to see *davka* (specifically) red, blue, green and yellow. But you have not actually seen yet.
**Prepared already with an estimation and in a limited way**, as in the soul's third level: every detail of how it will be *b'poel* (in actuality) is set; it is only not done yet.

phrases.he: ולמעלה,
phrases.en: and above in G-dliness,

phrases.he: היינו מה ששיער בעצמות אור אין סוף שנקרא טהירו עילאה
phrases.en: this is the estimation that G-d made in the *Atzmus Ein Sof*, which is called the upper purity,

phrases.he: באופן ושיעור מה שרוצה בהשתלשלות בפועל התגלות דקו עד סוף עולם העשיה
phrases.en: that G-d estimated exactly what He wants to happen in the *hishtalshelus* when He actually makes it come revealed from the *Kav* all the way to the end of the world of *Asiya*,

phrases.he: שזהו מה שכתוב גליף גליפו בטהירו עילאה כנזכר לעיל
phrases.en: this is what it says that He engraved an engraving in the upper purity, like we said before,

blocks.text: **Above in G-dliness, this is the estimation that G-d made in the Atzmus Ein Sof**: **exactly what He wants to happen in the hishtalshelus** **all the way to the end of the world of Asiya** (Action), down to "the last hair on your head", how many and which way they curve.

**He engraved an engraving in the upper purity**, *glif glifu*: the letters, estimating exactly how our *hishtalshelus* will come out. He knows not only the power of kindness and the *sefiros d'ein ketz*, but every world and creature He could make, in every detail, and chooses which to make.

phrases.he: והוא הנקרא בחינת קדמון,
phrases.en: this is what's called *Kadmon*,

phrases.he: דהיינו מה שקדם אופן הרצון להשפיע טרם שמשפיע עדיין בגלוי ממש
phrases.en: *Kadmon* means to precede, meaning that He already preceded within Himself exactly the way that He's going to want to be *mashpia* before He actually did it.

phrases.he: וזהו עדיין לפני הצמצום הראשון
phrases.en: And this is still before the first *tzimtzum*.

phrases.he: הנקרא מקום פנוי וחלל כו' כנ"ל וד"ל.

blocks.text: **This is what's called Kadmon.** **Kadmon means to precede**: **He already preceded within Himself exactly the way that He's going to want to be mashpia** (give) **before He actually did it**, every detail planned. **And this is still before the first tzimtzum.**

Rabbi Walters once saw it explained, he thinks in a *sicha* (a talk), that to really appreciate the *Aibershter* you must see Him three ways: higher than everything, *Yachid*, beyond all limits, *sefiros* and creations; including all things; and in every last thing, even in our physical world, each with a unique *maala* (virtue) and *gilui* of the *etzem*. His being includes *mamash* every particular being.

These are three levels in the *Or Ein Sof*; an actual *or* needs a *tzimtzum*. In the *Maor* (the source of light) there is only a *yecholes*; *Kadmon* has *mamash* every thing in our world. An apple was there before the *tzimtzum*, seen as a *gilui* of G-d, not as an apple; the *tzimtzumim* hide everything but the apple.

sections.title: The fourth level: after the tzimtzum, the reshimu, the Kav and the lower purity
sections.summary: After the first *tzimtzum* an impression is left, the *reshimu*, and from it the *Kav*: the *tehiru tata'a*, the general *makif* of the whole chain, where G-d is still all that is revealed but already as relating to something separate. The light after the *tzimtzum* is to the light before it as physical growth to the spiritual power of growth, and the *tzimtzum* is needed so that a finite, measured light can be the source of the four worlds.

phrases.he: ומדריג' הד'
phrases.en: and the fourth level,

phrases.he: הוא מה שאחר הצמצום הנזכר לעיל נשאר בחינת הרשימו
phrases.en: is how after this *tzimtzum*, this first *tzimtzum*, there is left an impression.

phrases.he: ונמשך ממנו הקו
phrases.en: and from this *reshimu* comes the *Kav*.

phrases.he: שהוא בכללות בחינת טהירו תתאה,
phrases.en: which in general this is the *tehiru tata'a*, the lower purity.

phrases.he: בחינת מקיף כללי לכל השתלשלות דקו כו'
phrases.en: and this is the general *makif* that includes everything that's going to come out in the *Kav*.

phrases.he: שזהו הבא בבחינת השפעה למטה מן העצמות,
phrases.en: this is already the light that comes out to go lower than the *Atzmus*, to be brought down to a *mekabel*.

blocks.text: The *nimshal* of *Yachid*, *Echad* and *Kadmon* is done. Next: the following step in the *hishtalshelus*, introducing the next chapter and showing how all that comes after the *tzimtzum* connects back to these three.
**And the fourth level is how after this tzimtzum, this first tzimtzum, there is left an impression**: the *reshimu*, the impression of the original light. **And from this reshimu comes the Kav.**

blocks.question: Why is the tzimtzum not counted as the fourth level?
blocks.text: The *tzimtzum* is not a level of the *or* but a process the *or* undergoes. The next real stage is the *reshimu*, an impression of the original light, explained at the end of the next chapter; the *Kav* comes after.

**Which in general this is the tehiru tata'a, the lower purity**, **the general makif** (encompassing light) **that includes everything that's going to come out in the Kav.** *Tehiru* means pure: *tehiru ila'a* reveals G-d Himself to Himself; *tehiru tata'a* still only reveals Him, but already as something separate.

blocks.title: Light in its source, out of it, and through the glasses
blocks.text: There is no actual *mekabel* (receiver) yet. But *tehiru ila'a* is like light within its source, *tehiru tata'a* like the light that came out, still wholly revealing its source; then it passes through glasses and curtains, and the source can no longer be seen.

So the *tehiru tata'a* is the *makif* of this *hishtalshelus*, whose real point is to reveal G-d; the *tehiru ila'a* encompasses all *hishtalshelusim*. **This is already the light that comes out to go lower than the Atzmus, to be brought down to a mekabel.**

phrases.he: כמשל חיות המתפשט בגלוי להחיות כו'
phrases.en: like an analogy of the life force, the consciousness, that spreads into the body to bring out the life in the body,

phrases.he: וככח התנועה שמתפשטת להניע הנפעל בגלוי כו'
phrases.en: or like the power of movement that when it actually spreads out,

phrases.he: שמשתנה ממהות רוחני למהות הגשמה
phrases.en: at that point it changes from being a spiritual thing, a spiritual essence, a spiritual nature, to being a physical thing.

phrases.he: כנזכר לעיל
phrases.en: like we said before.

blocks.text: Like **the life force, the consciousness, that spreads into the body** to see, hear and touch, **or like the power of movement that when it actually spreads out**: *Yachid*, *Echad* and *Kadmon* are levels of your ability to move, and actually moving, the lower purity, reveals it in a particular thing. **It changes from being a spiritual thing…to being a physical thing**, and that needs the *tzimtzum*, as at the end of chapter 10.

phrases.he: וכמו צמיחה גשמית מצמיחה רוחנית
phrases.en: or like physical growth of an actual plant from the spiritual power of growth,

phrases.he: כך הוא ערך האור שאחר הצמצום
phrases.en: This is similarly the relationship between the light after the *tzimtzum*

phrases.he: לגבי האור העצמי שלפני הצמצום
phrases.en: to the light before the *tzimtzum*,

phrases.he: דמשום זה הוצרך להיות ענין הצמצום הזה,
phrases.en: and this is why there has to be this *tzimtzum*,

phrases.he: רק בשביל שיוכל להיות הארת האור שבקו,
שבא בשביל מקור לאבי''ע כידוע
phrases.en: And then it can be the source for the worlds of *Atzilus*, *Beriya*, *Yetzira*, *Asiya*.

blocks.text: **Or like physical growth of an actual plant from the spiritual power of growth**: so is **the light after the tzimtzum** **to the light before the tzimtzum**, "a complete qualitative quantum leap" from infinite to finite, from G-d Himself to a particular thing, like the ten *sefiros*, through which He is seen.

**And this is why there has to be this tzimtzum.** For the light to come out measured and finite, which is the *Kav*, the *tzimtzum* must come first. **And then it can be the source for the worlds of Atzilus, Beriya, Yetzira, Asiya.**

sections.title: Everything after the tzimtzum was first in the Essence
sections.summary: The point of bringing the fourth level here: all the details of the ten *sefiros* of the four worlds were included at first in the *hiyuli* of the *Atzmus Or Ein Sof*, and the *tzimtzum* only changes them into a limited, general influence. So the soul already holds every perception before the body triggers it, like white light that holds every color the stained glass lets through.

phrases.he: אך עם כל זה הרי כל פרטי העשר ספירות דאבי''ע,
phrases.en: nevertheless, all the details, the ten *sefiros*, in all the levels of *hishtalshelus*, in *Atzilus*, *Beriya*, *Yetzira*, *Asiya*,

phrases.he: הכל כלולים מתחלה בעצמות אור אין סוף בבחינת היולי ועצמי
phrases.en: all of those details were originally included in the *Atzmus Or Ein Sof*, in the *hiyuli* in the *Atzmus Or Ein Sof*.

phrases.he: ואחר כך על ידי הצמצום משתנה לפי אופן מוגבל בהשפעה הכללית דקו בבחינת סובב
phrases.en: Then, through the *tzimtzum*, it gets changed to be, instead of this essential *hiyuli* power, revealed as a general power that relates specifically to what's going to come out in the *hishtalshelus*,

blocks.text: This is why the fourth level is brought here: though the *tzimtzum* stands between *Kadmon* and the *reshimu*, **all the details, the ten sefiros, in all the levels of hishtalshelus**, in all four worlds, **were originally included in the Atzmus Or Ein Sof**. What comes out now was there before.

**Then, through the tzimtzum, it gets changed**: no longer the essential *hiyuli* power, it is revealed as a general power relating to what will come out in the *hishtalshelus*, more and more detailed as it goes down.

phrases.he: והרי זה כדוגמת חיות הנפש הרוחנית כשבאה להחיות הגוף
phrases.en: this is like when a person's soul's power of consciousness comes into the body,

phrases.he: שכלולה ברוחניות מכל פרטי חיות הגשמיות, ראיה ושמיעה שבגוף הגשמי כנזכר לעיל
(וענין הצמצום והרשימה יתבאר בסמוך)
phrases.en: and we will explain the idea of *tzimtzum* and *reshimu* soon in the next chapters.

blocks.text: **This is like when a person's soul's power of consciousness comes into the body.** The soul already had sight, hearing, smell and touch, red and blue, every sensation; in the body, certain things are linked to trigger them. Perception is not really physical but "psychophysical, that's what they call them": the soul's reaction to a stimulus. The perceptions are in your soul; the body only triggers them.

blocks.title: White light through stained glass
blocks.text: Like light through stained glass: white light has all the colors, and a blue glass hides the red and yellow and shows only the blue. So the soul's self-awareness already holds every perception of color and sound; the body filters them, so the soul focuses on certain aspects of itself. The body only triggers which *tzimtzum* happens.

blocks.question: Why does this fourth level belong here, among the levels of the Atzmus?
blocks.text: Why is a level after the *tzimtzum* counted among the levels of the *Atzmus*? From the *hishtalshelus*' point of view it is separate. But, as the next chapter explains, the *tzimtzum* is not *kipshuto* (literal): all after it reveals *mamash* what was before, only *metzumtzam* (contracted), still *mamash* a revelation of G-d.

**We will explain the idea of tzimtzum and reshimu soon in the next chapters.** The level is here because the *reshimu*, with all its details, was included before the *tzimtzum*: the letters of *Kadmon* for this *hishtalshelus*, without the light, so you do not see that they reveal G-d. So all after the *tzimtzum* still reveals G-d Himself.

The birthday present, the shoes and the coat come from the store; only the desire to give them comes from your *hiyuli* of kindness. But the actual blue and red of perception come from your soul and happen in it, received into yourself, going up, not out. So that *mashal* shows how everything *mamash* comes from before.

sections.title: Baruch She'amar: "He said", "and there was", "the world"
sections.summary: The levels are read into the opening of *Baruch She'amar*: "He said" in concealment is *Yachid*, "and there was" is *Echad*, "the world", what He estimated, is *Kadmon*. Then the chapter jumps ahead: *Baruch Hu*, hidden, is the origin of the world, the estimation without its light; "says and does" is the *Kav* in actuality, "makes the beginning" is *Adam Kadmon*, and "decrees and fulfils" is the *kav hamida* before it.

phrases.he: (וזהו פירוש כללי למה שכתוב
ברוך שאמר והיה העולם
phrases.en: "Blessed is He that said and the world came to be."

phrases.he: פירוש שאמר בהעלם, ברצונו הפשוט שבמלכות דאין סוף,
phrases.en: He said it to Himself, so it was like still hidden within His simple desire of *Malchus d'Ein Sof*,

phrases.he: בהיותו עדיין כלול בחפץ חסד העצמי הנזכר לעיל
phrases.en: the way it's still included in the *chafetz chesed ha'atzmi*.

phrases.he: ואחר כך והיה,
phrases.en: and then it came to be,

phrases.he: בגלוי אור המתפשט לדבר פרט
phrases.en: that already *v'haya* means that it's already coming out as something. We don't know what yet, but it's coming to a particular thing,

phrases.he: להשתלשלות, להיות מקור לכל העולמות
phrases.en: to be a source for all of the worlds.

blocks.text: Now the *Mitteler Rebbe* (Rabbi DovBer of Lubavitch, the author) explains the opening words of *Baruch She'amar* by these levels, and by some explained later, so you have to come back to it: **"Blessed is He that said and the world came to be."**

**He said it to Himself, so it was like still hidden within His simple desire of Malchus d'Ein Sof**, in the essential *chafetz chesed*: in *Yachid*. **And then it came to be**, *v'haya*: **it's coming to a particular thing**, **to be a source for all of the worlds**, the general light, *Echad*.

phrases.he: ופירוש והיה העולם,
phrases.en: and what does it mean, "and the world came to be"?

phrases.he: היינו דווקא מן מה ששיער בעצמו בכח
phrases.en: that means that the world came out according to what G-d said, the way that He estimated that He wanted the world, that's exactly the way the world comes out.

phrases.he: שהוא שרש מה שמתהווה אחר כך העולם הכללי שנמשך מן הקו וכו' וכנזכר לעיל ודי למבין.
phrases.en: And this estimation in Himself of exactly what's going to be is the source of everything that comes out into the world after the *tzimtzum* in the *Kav* and everything,

blocks.text: **"And the world came to be"**: **the world came out according to what G-d said, the way that He estimated that He wanted the world.** The details, *ha'olam*, are *Kadmon*, the source of all that comes out **after the tzimtzum in the Kav**.

Read simply, "Blessed is He that said and the world came to be" is one title for G-d Himself, with three stages. *She'amar*, the One who said: a total *hiyuli*, the bare ability to say, with nothing separate from Him. *V'haya*, something came to be: ready to come out, without details. *Ha'olam*: the exact details. Yet all are part of "He said". So they are *Yachid*, *Echad* and *Kadmon*, *v'dai l'mevin* (and this is enough for one who understands).

blocks.text: *Baruch Hu*, **"Blessed is He,"** no longer says whom we mean: third person, no description. **So that's the idea of nistar** (hidden): *kadmono shel olam*, **that G-d precedes the world, that He's like the origin of the world.**

This is G-d as the source of what comes out: the letters estimated in *Kadmon*, becoming the world's source, like the *reshimu*, with the light hidden. So you no longer know He is the One who said; you see only the mysterious source of the world, "the great cosmic secret or something."

blocks.text: *Magid mereishis acharis*, **that G-d says from the beginning to the end**: simply, He knows the future; here, He dictated the whole *hishtalshelus* from beginning to end, **and before it actually happened, He says what's going to be**.

**Kadmono shel olam** is called *yemei kedem*, **the olden days**, as in the good old days, **which precedes what goes into the Kav**: **the whole estimation of what's going to actually happen, that preceded within Himself.**

phrases.he: שהוא בחינת צמצום דרשימו שנמשך ממנו הקו כידוע, וכמו שיתבאר בעזרת השם בסמוך):

blocks.text: **"Blessed is He that says and does"**: this second saying is the one that comes out *b'poel*, the first circle of the *Kav*, the *ratzon kadum* (the preceding will), explained later. From it, *oseh bereishis*, **it makes the beginning, which that is Adam Kadmon** (the first world), all its *partzufim* (statures), *sefiros* and details.

Between them comes *gozer u'mekayem* ("who decrees and fulfils"), the *kav hamida*: **the measuring line is before Adam Kadmon**, dividing it into ten circles and bringing it into the *yosher* (the upright line). This is the *tzimtzum* of the *reshimu*: the *Kav* measures everything out as estimated in the *reshimu*, as will be explained.

reviewQuestions.question: If *Yachid* has no parts, in what sense are the ten *sefiros* there? How does the kind person's kindness show it, and why can't you teach a computer to be kind?
Why is it a *chiddush* that even *Malchus* is in the *Atzmus Or Ein Sof*, and what follows from its being infinite for the details of a *mitzva*?
What does it mean that at the level of *Echad* the *sefiros* are united and yet *b'li ma*, "without a what"? How does the man who wants "to do a nice thing" illustrate it?
How do the basketball player and the eye ready to see illustrate *Kadmon*, the third level?
Why is the level after the *tzimtzum* brought here among the levels of the *Atzmus*, and why is the soul's perception in the body a better *mashal* for it than the birthday present?
How do "He said", "and there was" and "the world" in *Baruch She'amar* correspond to *Yachid*, *Echad* and *Kadmon*?
